latin: Proprium est supermundanorum deorum assimilare et tradere entibus compassionem illam et inuicem communionem, quam habent ex similitudine unius ad alterum.
translation: It is the property of the supermundane gods to assimilate to beings, and to hand down to them that sympathy and mutual communion which they have from the likeness of one to another.
